Fixed Account Entry to pre-fill User details when provided.
Updated Obsidian Login block error message when passwordless code fails to send to mobile phone.
Fixed the My Account page's PublicProfile.lava to use configuration settings so the Title can be optionally shown on the view screen.
Improved the wording of a few requirement related settings in the Group Member Detail block.
Fixed an issue where the selected Connection Status was not being saved when the "Create Record From Fields" button was used when creating a new Benevolence Request.
Fixed issue with Signature Document blocks not honoring the Template's Security.
Added the ability to pin Notes to the top of the list.
Fixed an issue where the 'Send Group Requirements Notification' job would still send notifications to members of the AccountabilityGroup even if they were not active.
Fixed a bug where the Documents block would sometimes show a configuration error message when there really was no configuration error.
Added the 'Add Connection Request' block.
Fixed issue in Obsidian Login block where unconfirmed passwordless accounts could not log in and no error displayed for locked out passwordless accounts.
Updated the Group Schedule Toolbox with the new Obsidian framework. Also, added features to allow displaying immediate needs.
Added the ability to use existing signed documents for event registrations if one already exists for the registrant.
Updated avatar caching logic to reduce the number of avatars cached.
Fixed Google authentication button not displaying icon.
Fixed an issue that caused some reversed transactions to be incorrectly calculated as positive transaction amounts in the Giving Overview.
Fixed the Checkin Group List to correctly identify circular references in the Group Type inheritance chain.
Fixed the Entity Command encountering an error when filtering on some Attribute Fields.
Fixed issue of Giving Alerts creating Connection Requests with missing fields.
Resolved an issue where there were problems handling single-line notes (comments) written within the code.
Fixed issue of history entries not being created for Financial Batch Detail Obsidian Block.
Fixed an issue causing transactions entered in the Transaction Entry V2 block to overwrite existing phone numbers.
Fixed the LocationPicker to correctly validate content when set to required.
Fixed the Transaction List block filter to show the correct attributes based on the current mode.
Updated the ScheduledTransactionEditV2 block with more options for allowing/changing which accounts the transaction can be used with the transaction.
Fixed Dynamic Data Grid Filters displaying incorrectly when all the Grid Actions are disabled.

Fixed issue of Person Entry in Form Builder not saving the Spouse GUID.

Fixed issue with Account Picker not closing after selection is made from search.
Added BreadCrumbs to Finance Batch Detail Obsidian Block.
Fixed an issue with the Transaction Entity Matching block that required reloading the page after saving to make a new selection.
Updated Obsidian Group Scheduler block to show minimum/desired/maximum capacity progress bar markers to the right of the spot that satisfies a given value.

Fixed issue with Metrics List block's Defined Value filters that auto-filled other filters when a defined value is selected.

Updated real-time system to ignore remote host closed connection errors.
Fixed Schedule Builder to display Schedule exclusions.

Fixed issue where copying a page did not honor block security settings on the copied page.

Fixed a problem where viewing a reminder for a deleted entity would cause an error.

Fixed an issue that could cause the NCOA update process to fail when someone moved more than 10,000 miles.
Added support for separate "API key" and "HTTP webhook signing key" values within Mailgun integration.
Updated the Attendance Detail block to correctly list Schedules, Locations and Groups available for moving checked-in individuals within the check-in manager.
Updated the En Route block to correctly list Schedules, Locations and Groups available for moving en-route individuals within the check-in manager.
Fixed an issue where a recipient's address might not be included on a financial statement generated using the "FinancialGivingStatement" v1 API.
Fixed Group List Block's Root Group not being set.

Fixed Connection Request to always get displayed, sorted by Order.

Increased the length of the Content Channel Item Slug from 75 to 200 characters.
Added new ToIdHash and FromIdHash Lava filters.
Fixed misspelled 'ProcessSendRegistrationNotification' class.
Updated the ModelMap to show table names when they do not match the model's name. This is useful for plugins that use a different table naming convention.
Added new Observability feature to Rock that allows Rock to send open telemetry data to an application monitoring service like NewRelic.
Updated the Workflow's WorkflowId database property to no longer compute the value using a database function. This should increase performance in certain situations.
Updated options on the Registration List Lava (a.k.a. Recent Registrations) block where many settings have changed. Please review the settings on the block and set to meet your needs

Fixed UI of notes block to make it easier to distinguish private notes.

Fixed Group Scheduler from incorrectly collapsing groups.

Fixed an issue where an empty Mailgun webhook signing key can cause an excessive number of errors to be added to the Exception Log.

Improved the Mailgun integration to use the API Key for tracking opens, etc. if the HTTP Webhook Signing Key is not defined, as well as logging a single exception to alert Rock admins of this missing key value.
Improved Security.
Improved performance of check-in cache after a change such as closing a location.
Fixed issue of Giving Overview block crashing when person has batch with only tax excluded contributions.
Fixed Utility Payment block to allow non-public accounts when provided in the URL.
Updated the Campus Context Setter block to have settings to provide a default Campus and to optionally update the individual's primary family Campus on change.
Updated age brackets to split 0-12 into two separate brackets.

Fixed Workflow processing intervals over 999 minutes getting erased.
Updated Utility Payment Entry to render Accounts in the order they are added.

Improved Security.

Fixed including archived Group Members from Post Filter Transformation.
Fixed an issue in the 15.0 update package where the structured content editor files were removed. The 15.1 package will restore these files if needed.
Fixed issue of inactive account being set as the default account when new Registrations Instances are created.
Fixed issue on the "Metric Detail" block when using "Flot" style charts.

Added additional properties related to refunds to the Financial Transaction List block.
Fixed issue with the CampusAccountAmountPicker where setting certain properties caused the selected campus values to be lost.
Fixed errors on the TransactionEntryV2 block that can occur when being used by a user that is not logged in.
Fixed issue on the WorkflowEntryBlock where a default message was displayed instead of the form's submit button text on form submission.

Fixed issue where attendance taken with Obsidian Group Attendance Detail block shows 100% attendance regardless of how many people were marked as having attended.
Fixed issue where Google Sign In did not work in Obsidian Login block.

Fixed an issue with rendering of Contact Information if Show Cell Phone Number First was changed.
Added new settings to the AccountEntry (New Account) block to allow attribute values to be supplied during new account registration.
Fixed an issue with line graphs for Goal and Measure in metrics.

Fixed issue where an orphaned FinancialPaymentDetail record could be left behind when the PaymentInfo on a scheduled transaction or saved account was changed.

Fixed an issue when searching content collections on an attribute with whitespace.
Updated the MetricDetail block to properly save attributes when creating a new metric.

Added new options to the Entity Command to prefetch (defaulted to on) attributes. This will significantly improve Lava templates using entity commands that then display attributes from those entities.
Fixed issue with export calendar feed function not displaying Occurrences that are copied/edited from existing Occurrences.
Updated the internal Registration Detail block so it only supports payments "hosted" gateways. If using the NMI Gateway the tokenizer key will need to be set.
For use with Personalization, updated the Request Filter block with a new Environment section, and updated the filter logic.
Added new properties and defined types for capturing race and ethnicity as needed on person profiles.
Added new workflow action to enable adding new groups to Rock.
Added new workflow action to update a persisted dataset.
Add UTM variable tracking to short link usage.
Updated communication mediums to support security. This allows restricting who can SMS, Push Notify and/or Email individuals.
Fixed issue with WorkflowEntry block where Activity Attributes were not visible when workflow is not persisted.
Fixed an issue where genderless profile pictures would appear in the benevolence request filter block in cases where the person has a defined gender but no profile picture.
Updated profile page tags to allow tags to appear with the correct user defined color.
Fixed formatting issues when using 'Paste from Word'.
Updated Duplicate Finder procedure to include Persons matched by PhoneNumber but with unknown gender(s).
Fixed an issue in the Obsidian Registration Entry block where an NMI gateway would get a "Billing Information Missing" error if the registration costs were only from fees.
Added the ability to view connection request attributes on the cards when in board view.
Fixed issue with TagReport block not allowing sorting by TaggedDate.
Updated theme files to include user added CSS after the files provided by the theme.
Improved the SMS Conversations feature adding a new message filter option to the block.
Modified the GivingAutomation processor to consider same-day transactions as a single giving event when calculating giving frequency.
Fixed the Content Channel View block (and others) to correctly remove Lava shorthand comments from displayed content.
Added a Maximum Field setting for Report Fields that support long text values.
Updated the Calculate Metric Job to replace only the Measure Metric on sourcing the data from SQL.
Fixed 'Group' Data Views to return Child Groups that are inactive.
Added passwordless authentication block for use with websites.
Updated SMS Phone Numbers to use new model instead of Defined Values.
Fixed some Lava blocks to correctly process parameter values containing embedded Lava.

Fixed the Person Following List block to correctly show all followings linked to Person records.
Fixed Rock's API Docs page to work with Rock instances that exist behind a 'reverse proxy'.

Updated Personalization Segment Detail block to allow filtering Page Views by URL or Referrer.
Added new data view filters to allow finding people based on their first attendance in groups or group types.
Updated the RockUpdate block and added an administrator checklist item to account for ending support of SQL Server 2014 and Legacy Lava in a future version of Rock.
Added the Communication Entry block, providing a way to send email and SMS communications to a list of recipients.
Added new avatar feature to Rock to create more feature rich icons to represent individuals in the database. See: https://community.rockrms.com/styling/components/avatars for details.
Fixed a bug where moving a phone number to a different phone type does not save.
Added support for some multi-value attributes to content collections.
Improved the Group Member List block, added a variety of filters, new default template and the ability to generate entity sets.
Added support for custom Lava fields in content collection sources.
Updated Person Group History block to add the ability to switch views between Year and Month.
Fixed issue with AccountPicker "Select All" not selecting child accounts.
Update to work around invalid XML from NMI query API.
Added settings to the new "Send Group Attendance Reminders" job to allow for sending reminders closer to the time of the attendance occurrence.
Improved the Search block by adding auto-search, scroll to load more, historical search items and performance improvements.
Added the ability to persist data views on a schedule to allow finer control over when they are run.
Updated Group Member List block to show 'Met' requirements correctly.
Added new Sign-ups feature for managing and allowing people to sign up for various short-term serving projects, teams, etc. that may have space/slot constraints.
Added registration instance details to financial transaction summary for registrations performed via the internal Rock site to help reconcile transactions.
Added the ability for financial accounts to be set to whether transactions within it are Shown in the Giving Overview Block.
Added rate limiting functionality to CMS Pages.
Update to ensure the correct group is shown when the Group Tree View is loaded.
Fixed the Parents and Children filters to exclude peers.
Updated the group attendance detail block to save in real-time with an updated user interface.

Fixed reprint labels with check-in by phone number so that people with the “can check-in" relationship appear.

Added support for separate "API key" and "HTTP webhook signing key" values within Mailgun integration.

Fixed issue where Check Scanner could confuse the check number as part of Account Number. If experiencing this issue, please download the updated Check Scanner app found under Power Tools > External Applications.

Updated the "Scheduling Confirmation Email" system communication template to include new capability for the Accept All feature.

Added a new IsPublic property to named schedules to allow for showing and hiding schedules when shown to individuals external to the organization. All current named schedules have been marked to be shown publicly to ensure this is not a breaking change.

Updated spAnalytics ETL Family Stored Procedure to update AnalyticsSourceFamilyHistorical if a family CampusId changes from NULL to non-NULL.
Fixed issue where CSS files were not updated during a Rock Update under certain conditions.
Updated the Communication List Subscription block to allow filtering by a Campus Context.

Added audit history notes when moving an event registration from one registration instance to another. This change also allows you to provide a message as to why you made the move.
